using System;

public class EnumObject
{
    public EnumObject()
    {
    }

    internal class Planet : JEnum
    {
        public static readonly Planet MERCURY = JLib.EnumMade(new Planet(3.3E+23), "MERCURY", 0);

        public static readonly Planet EARTH = JLib.EnumMade(new Planet(5.9E+24), "EARTH", 1);

        internal double mass;

        internal Planet(double mass)
        {
            this.mass = mass;
        }
    }

    internal enum Color
    {
        RED,
        GREEN
    }

    internal static int ok()
    {
        return Enum.GetValues<Color>().Length;
    }
}
